procedure: Bomb with one design and record population/installation losses.
Invade with a known colonist count and record losses and capture.
Confirm a starbase blocks both actions.

documented: Bombing begins automatically when no starbase remains; each bomb slot drops that many bombs per year (documented-only).
Enemy population reports are estimates within +/-20% (documented-only).
Planetary defenses are 75% effective against enemy colonist drops; survivors fight until one side remains (documented-only).
